title: ARENA Prerequisites: Einops Foundations
description: A hand-seeded first curriculum slice for explicit concept-graph tutoring. This slice focuses on the earliest einops rearrange skills that support later Delta Drills and ARENA tensor-manipulation work.

concepts.title: Axis semantics and shape vocabulary
concepts.description: Understand what each axis symbol refers to and preserve the same elements while changing layout.

concepts.title: Axis permutation
concepts.description: Reorder existing axes without composing or splitting them.

concepts.title: Axis composition and decomposition
concepts.description: Merge axes into grouped dimensions or split grouped dimensions back into factors.

concepts.title: Image layout conversion
concepts.description: Convert among BCHW, BHWC, HWC, and CHW style layouts while preserving image content.

concepts.title: Grid and patch rearrangements
concepts.description: Use composition plus permutation to build image grids, patches, and space-to-depth style transformations.

prerequisite_edges.rationale: Students need to know what each axis means before reordering them.
Axis grouping and splitting depend on reliable shape vocabulary.
Layout conversion is a concrete application of axis reordering.
Patch and grid problems require splitting and regrouping spatial axes.
Many grid tasks also involve moving the new axes into a usable order.

lessons.title: Visual intuition warm-up
lessons.summary: The first image-based ARENA prerequisites build shape vocabulary by visually manipulating rows, columns, channels, and stretching patterns.

lessons.title: Function-based rearrange basics
lessons.summary: The first function-implementation rearrange exercises convert visual intuition into explicit tensor expressions.

lessons.title: Layout round-trips and grid assembly
lessons.summary: Delta Drills rearrange items test whether the learner can compose, permute, and then invert the same transformation without losing track of spatial structure.

problem_links.notes: Pure transpose: swap height and width.
Move batch into width and then recover the original arrangement.
Split a sequence into fixed-size chunks.
Make a 2x3 grid from the first 6 images.

mastery_gate.notes: Core concepts unlock only after every hard-gate prerequisite reaches 0.8 mastery. Supplemental concepts can be served once the hard-gate chain is satisfied, but they should not block frontier progress.
